# FutureMarketingAI (FMai)

> FMai builds Clyde, the AI colleague of your agency (Dutch: AI-collega). Clyde works in a loop per client: goals and strategy, research, a content agenda per channel, execution (Clyde creates, the team and the client approve) and reporting that feeds the next goal. Skills for strategy, social media, blogs, ads, Instagram DMs, email, reporting and SEO/GEO, and a memory per client. The offer for new agencies since 2026-11-09 is Founding: 1297 EUR per month excl. VAT with 5 client brands included, 199 EUR per extra brand up to 15, 1500 credits per brand per month in one agency pool, 0 EUR onboarding, price fixed for 12 paid months, 3 founding spots. Regular plans follow after Founding, expected around 2400-2500 EUR per month for 5 brands; after the 12 fixed months founding partners pay 30% below the regular price while they stay. Servers and database in the EU; the language model runs at Anthropic and OpenAI (US). A setup with Mistral, a European language model, can be built on request. Application-gated: no self-service signup.

FMai is an AI marketing partnership founded by Daley for marketing agencies in the Netherlands and the EU with 5 to 20 people managing 5 to 15 client brands. Instead of isolated AI tools, FMai provides one AI colleague named Clyde who knows the goals of every client, works in every screen of the dashboard and on WhatsApp, and keeps a memory per client. Per task the agency decides what Clyde proposes first and what he may do himself and report. The agency's client gets their own dashboard, approves there, sends requests to the agency and talks to Clyde on WhatsApp. The first client is SkinClarity Club: 3 Instagram accounts, all live skills switched on, and FutureMarketingAI is the agency that approves the content.

The product is not a self-serve SaaS. Every engagement starts with an application at https://future-marketing.ai/nl/apply. Daley reviews personally within 48 hours.

Pricing canon: Founding A1.4, 2026-11-09 (mirrored in `src/lib/pricing-data.ts` of this site). Growth, Professional and Enterprise are no longer for sale. Existing founding partners keep their agreement as signed; it is not retroactively adjusted.

Contact: hello@future-marketing.ai. Canonical domain: https://future-marketing.ai. Languages: Dutch (source of truth), English.

## Core pages

- [Home (NL)](https://future-marketing.ai/nl): Clyde, the loop from client goal to report, the team and the client, the entrances (dashboard, WhatsApp and the web app on your home screen), from post to lead, control and EU data, FAQ.
- [Memory](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/memory): How Clyde keeps a memory per client: the conversation, memories from conversations and feedback, strategy and research per client. Memories about a client belong to that agency and that client.
- [Pricing](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/pricing): What Clyde costs. The offer today is Founding (section #founding): 1297 EUR per month excl. VAT, 5 client brands included, 199 EUR per extra brand up to 15, 1500 credits per brand per month in one pool for the agency, 0 EUR onboarding, price fixed for 12 paid months, cancel monthly, 3 founding spots. Enough for a balanced month per brand, for example about 20 unique pieces (12 posts, 4 carousels, 4 shorts from the brand's own footage) and about 40 placements on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, with X and Threads where they fit the brand, plus a blog, a research memo, an SEO/GEO check, a monthly report and Clyde. The agency approves the work itself; guidance is available on request. Extra credits: 500 for 40 EUR, 2000 for 160 EUR, 5000 for 400 EUR. Not included: AI video, voice-over, ads. Regular plans follow after Founding, expected around 2400-2500 EUR per month for 5 brands; after the 12 fixed months founding partners pay 30% below the regular price while they stay.
- [Alternatives (NL)](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/alternatives): Honest comparison with Lindy, Sintra, GoSocio and aicollegas.nl, checked 2026-11-03: what each does, its price, how it handles multiple clients and data, and when it suits an agency better than Clyde.
- [Apply](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/apply): Application form for partnership. Name, email, agency and role are required; the rest is optional. Response within 48 hours.
- [How it works](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/how-it-works): 4-week onboarding, a workspace per client, approvals and control per task, a correction loop in the first month.
- [About](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/about): Founder Daley. Why partnership over SaaS.
- [Cases](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/case-studies): Two real clients with FutureMarketingAI as the agency: SkinClarity Club (skincare, 3 Instagram accounts, May to October 2026) and SalesLobe (B2B, the brand's Instagram and the founder's LinkedIn, since October 2026). No revenue, reach or lead figures.
- [Case: SkinClarity Club](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/case-studies/skinclarity-club): Our first client, with FutureMarketingAI as the agency. From May to October 2026 Clyde made the posts for 3 Instagram accounts (the club, the webshop and the skin therapist), each in its own voice, from one memory; a post went live only after approval in the app. Shows the real calendar of the week of 12 October 2026.
- [Case: SalesLobe](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/case-studies/saleslobe): B2B client, with FutureMarketingAI as the agency. Since 5 October 2026 Clyde makes the brand's Instagram and the LinkedIn of founder Paul den Hartogh, in English, each post approved in the app before it goes live. Shows one topic in both voices (a LinkedIn post of 23 October and an Instagram carousel of 27 October 2026) and the voice round that came first. No revenue, reach or lead figures.
- [Client portal](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/client-portal): What the agency's client sees and does in their own portal, in the agency's name with white-label on: approve, reject or ask for a change (only a manager on the client's team approves), the calendar and reports, their own images and requests through one form. The client's own Clyde only reads. Real screens of the demo client Dagspa Luwte.
- [Contact](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/contact): Simple form. For partnership inquiries use Apply instead.

## Skills

- [What Clyde makes](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills): What Clyde does per client, in the order of a working week: plan, make, approve and publish, from post to lead, measure, plus the mailbox. One memory per client, and nothing goes live without approval.
- [Social Media Manager](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/social-media): Captions in brand voice, a content calendar per account, carousels in the house style and performance per post. Publishes to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, TikTok and YouTube after approval. Live.
- [Blog Factory](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/blog-factory): SEO articles from keyword research to publication after approval; length follows the search intent. Live.
- [Ad Manager](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/ad-manager): Static and video ads prepared for Meta, live only after approval, then followed per ad on conversions, ROAS and ad fatigue. Not included in the Founding offer. Live.
- [From post to lead](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/lead-qualifier): Instagram comments and DMs with a keyword get a DM with the matching link; Clyde writes the follow-up in the brand voice for approval, and leads from the link land in the lead list. Live.
- [Email Management](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/email-management): Gmail and Outlook inbox classification with labels and draft replies sent after approval. Live.
- [Reporting and Analytics](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/reporting): A weekly report per brand, a dashboard per client refreshed daily, and an alert on strong deviations. Live.
- [SEO / GEO Analyst](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/seo-geo): Technical SEO, positions from Search Console, Core Web Vitals and AI citation monitoring. Live.
- [Strategy and research](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/strategy): A strategy page per client with the goal, the audience, the platforms, the goals and a calendar for the year, plus research signals on trends and competitors with source and date. Clyde proposes, the agency decides. Live.
- [Working with Clyde](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/clyde): How an agency works with Clyde in the dashboard, in the web app on your home screen and on WhatsApp: what Clyde does himself (drafts, fixed tasks, memory per client), what he puts to you (under For you, or on WhatsApp with Run and Cancel) and what only you do (approve, pause). Live.
- [Coming soon](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills#binnenkort): Voice Agent (phone calls for a client: questions, appointments and handover to a person) and Reel Builder (short vertical videos per client). Not live yet.
